description: Send exactly one message to a person through their three.ws door. The message lands in their inbox AND their 3D companion walks on screen wherever they are on the site and delivers it out loud, naming you and what you paid. On a FREE door this sends immediately. On a PRICED door this tool does not pay and cannot pay: it returns `payment_required` together with the recipient, the amount, the token, the chain and the endpoint, so a human can approve the spend and pay from their own wallet (npx @three-ws/knock, or any x402 client). Pass `request_id` to make retries safe: the same id never knocks, or charges, twice. Refusals (shut door, daily cap, message too long) happen before any payment, so a rejected knock is never a paid one.

from.description: Who is knocking. Shown to them and spoken out loud.

message.description: The message. Shown in full, never read aloud.

request_id.description: Idempotency key. A retry returns the first knock instead of knocking twice.

subject.description: One line their companion says out loud. Make it the reason you are knocking.

to.description: Recipient username, with or without the @.

name: knock_send
title: Knock on a door
